$comment: Seed data for the six themed scoring days. In state 3574's rotation these apply to the State of Power week (one week in four) — confirm the day names against the in-game event page, since they are seeded from the general community pattern rather than that state's screen. POINT VALUES ARE NOT VERIFIED and should be checked in game, then corrected under Game Data.
sourceNote: Community-reported values, unverified. Correct them under Game Data > VS Duel.

days.name: Radar Training
days.summary: Stamina, radar missions and hero progression. The cheapest day to score if you bank stamina and hero shards through the weekend.
bank: Stamina (do not spend it Sunday — cap out and hold)
Hero shards and Widgets / recruitment tickets
Exploration and Intel (radar) missions left unclaimed

scoring.label: Stamina spent on radar / intel missions

tips: Finish Sunday with full stamina and let it overflow into stored stamina items.
Hold Fire Crystal hero shards for Day 5 if your alliance is pushing Total Mobilization instead.

days.name: Base Expansion
days.summary: Construction speedups and building power. Start a long upgrade Sunday night, then finish it with speedups on Monday.
bank: One long building upgrade queued and ready to rush
Fire Crystals / Refined Fire Crystals for Furnace levels
tips: Points come from the speedups you *use*, so queue the upgrade first and rush it during the day.
Do not let a big upgrade complete on its own overnight — that power lands outside the scoring window.

days.name: Age of Science
days.summary: Research speedups and research power. Same trick as Day 2 — have an expensive research queued and waiting.
bank: A long research queued the night before
Fire Crystals if your alliance counts them here
tips: Growth tree research is usually cheaper per point than Battle tree research.
If you only have General speedups, spend them on whichever of Day 2 / 3 / 4 your alliance most needs.

days.name: Train Troops
days.summary: Training speedups and troop promotion. Usually the easiest day to hit a high personal score.
bank: A full training queue started before reset
tips: Promoting existing troops usually scores far better per resource than training new ones.
Keep your troop queue full and rush it repeatedly rather than in one batch.

days.name: Total Mobilization
days.summary: Everything counts — speedups of all kinds, hero gear, chief gear and chief charms. The heaviest scoring day, and the one worth saving for.
bank: Any speedups left over from Days 2–4
Hero gear plates and Essence Stones
Chief Gear materials and Chief Charm materials
Fire Crystals and Refined Fire Crystals
tips: Chief Gear and Chief Charm upgrades are typically the highest-value single actions of the whole week.
Ask your R4/R5 whether the alliance is contesting this day before you dump everything into it.

days.name: Enemy Buster
days.summary: Killing enemy troops, rallies and healing. Points come from combat, so this day is coordinated, not solo.
bank: Full march queues and rally capacity
Hero stamina / rally slots for your rally leads
tips: Follow your alliance's call — solo attacking on this day usually just feeds the other side points.
Heal during the scoring window, not after it closes.
